summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Alexander Soros, son of billionaire George Soros and Susan Weber Soros. It covers his upbringing in Katonah, New York, his younger brother Gregory, his secondary schooling at King Low Heywood Thomas in Stamford, Connecticut, and his two university degrees: a 2009 graduation from New York University and a 2018 PhD in History from the University of California, Berkeley.
one_line: Biographical note on Alexander Soros, son of George Soros, covering his family, schooling, and education through his 2018 Berkeley history PhD.
key_facts: Alexander Soros is the son of billionaire George Soros and Susan Weber Soros.
Alexander Soros was raised in Katonah, New York.
Alexander Soros has a younger brother named Gregory.
Alex Soros attended King Low Heywood Thomas in Stamford, Connecticut.
Alex Soros graduated from New York University in 2009.
Alex Soros graduated with a PhD in History from the University of California, Berkeley in 2018.
